reviews.comment: Super easy class. I only went to lecture 2 or 3 times for extra credit but I ended up not needing it. Your grade is made up of mainly discussion posts and a debate group project. There are no exams.

By far the worst prof and worst experience I have had at A&M. She wants you to think she cares about you, when in reality that could not be further from the truth. Only prof I have ever had that wanted to make me withdraw from the university as a whole, and the professor that made me change my major. Do not take her.

SHE IS AMAZING! There was a total of 50 points worth of extra credit offered. Homework is worth more than exams, so if you do good on homework & the first two exams, you don't even have to take exam 3 to get an A in the class. The lab us super easy as well. There were only 15 in-person days during the entire semester, the other days were recorded.

I hate bugs, but I absolutely loved this class. I learned so much without having to stress out since there were no exams (bless!!). I had to move home halfway through the semester, but the prof. was very flexible and made sure I stayed on track for success from hours away. 10/10 rec. to anyone looking for an easy science credit & a cool prof!

Professor Faris was a very sweet prof who cared about what she teaches in her class. She makes the class very fun and engaging. The problem with the class was the extreme busy work. There was so much work to be completed and I spent most of my time working on her class compared to any other. The class was not hard though and it was interesting.

Amazing professor and was a very interesting class. Easy class, exams were over the main topics of the course, easy to study. Gives a lot of extra credit opportunities (about 29 pts for my class) and is really nice and approachable. Has been my favorite class in my 3 years of college
This class is a good amount of homework per week, but a free A. I went to class once the whole semester.

She gives out a lot of assignments but they aren't that difficult, you just have to follow the rubric and it can be done within 2 days. If you are taking harder classes, then be aware because you won't want to try as much in her assignments. You don't have to go to classes since attendance isn't required but I have a feeling she'll change that.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Faris has been one of my favorite professors. I have taken her since this class because she teaches so well and makes the content fun and engaging! She is also very willing to work with you on anything and it is clear she genuinely cares about the content AND her students.

If you are looking for an easy science credit, TAKE THIS CLASS! Attendance is not mandatory, however, there were many opportunities to gain extra credit by attending class.  Lots of busy work, but all relatively easy and very manageable.  This course also does not require tests.  110% recommend to anyone.

There were a lot of assignments, but outside from that Dr. Faris was a fun professor and gave frequent extra credit. I don't care much for insects but she made learning about them pretty fun and I enjoyed going to class.

Dr. Faris is the best! Her lectures are always very interesting and she does an amazing job of keeping the class engaged. There are ZERO tests, so the class is assignment-heavy. Miss one or make a bad grade? No problem. She offers multiple extra credit opportunities! She wants to see you have fun and succeed in her class! 100000% RECOMMEND!
Very easy class. Just stay on top of assignments and homework. The homework isn't hard but just takes a little time (30min-1hr max).
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was the first class I took at A&M and I loved it. Dr. Faris is amazing. I 100% recommend this class! There is no exams or final exam, so that's a big plus.

This is THE tamu science class for non-science people. Dr. Faris is very sweet and accommodating and she makes the class as fun as she can. She gives out TONS of resources to help students succeed and is always there if students need help. Literally adore her
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I am going to be honest, I have not been to this class since the first week of school. The assignments are all online, self-explanatory, and there are no tests. She is very accessible by email so even if I have a question I don't have to go to class. Definitely take this class if you need an easy science credit!! :)
If you don't know how to write a basic paper, do not take this class. #slay
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I adore her. I hate science of any kind but she made the class so fun. No tests but stay ahead on the work. Very doable class. She is one of the best

Dr. Faris is an awesome professor and if I could take her again I certainly would! She is super kind and always goes out of her way to make you feel supported. This class is pretty straightforward and as long as you do the assignments then you should be on track to get a pretty good grade.

Super sweet/fun women. A lot of work, but simple work. Follow rubrics and give yourself enough time for everything & this is such an easy A. NO TEST, but 3 papers (peerceptive), debate project, blog, weekly discussion post, 5 problem sets. A lot of assignments. Give yourself enough time, easy A, but you will have to earn it. LOTS OF EXTRA CREDIT!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Faris always gave great feedback on all assignments and exams. She denotes everything that is expected of you and is always willing to help during her office hours if you're struggling. This class was administered asynchronously online, but if you sped up the videos it's not too bad since she talks a bit slow. Overall, great professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Literally an angel. With COVID she made her class asynchronous online, and while we still had group projects, everything was timed out and manageable. She held so many office hours, gave extra credit quizzes for modules, and ensured we all enjoyed the class. She made it fun even though it was online which is rare! TAKE HER!

This class was a great course if you need a science credit! The professors are very clear about their expectations so make sure you follow the syllabus and instructions. They give great feedback. You definitely have to put in the work, but if you do it should be an easy A!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy
